Test launcher adaptation

pojav_jli.c adapts the JLI_Launch call and prototype from PojavLauncher
commit b12ad048157b3aa255d078c235dd4571e1900309, jre_launcher.c.
The Oracle copyright and GPL version 2 with Classpath exception header is
retained in that file. The remaining subprocess baseline, argument ownership
and reporting code was added for this project's test harness.

jre_host.c follows the preload/layout sequence in JREUtils.java and utils.c;
this is test-only startup scaffolding, not a packaged Pojav integration.
Exact upstream source paths and hashes are in tests/config/pojav-startup.json.

LICENSE contains GPL version 2 with the Classpath exception, from java.base
legal/LICENSE in the pinned angelaura-21-arm64 archive. That archive's identity
is recorded in tests/config/android-jres.json. The test APK also includes the
selected JRE's own legal files.
